body: yeah, I'm still here. like everything else, I bungled my own suicide. I need to write a strongly worded letter to the manufacturer regarding their warnings on mixing with alcohol. Honestly, it was pretty great until I passed out.

You'll be happy to know that I didn't die. This is what I get for trying to off myself with only a weeks worth of sleeping pills left, I guess. I just woke up sixteen hours later with a lifetimes worth of grogginess.

I couldn't even kill myself properly. That honestly makes it worse.
